name: Khunti Kadai
why_it_matters: Considered Agartala's go-to address for proper Bengali gharana cooking — Tripadvisor's #4 of 82 restaurants in the city, with reviewers consistently calling out the kasha mangsho, mochar ghonto and shorshe ilish. The 'bangaliana' soundtrack and AC sit-down format make it the safe pick when you want comfort food after a long Akhaura-Road day.
insider_tip: Open ~11:00 AM to ~10:30 PM daily. Located on HGB Road opposite Madan Mohan Mandir, Melarmath. Order shorshe ilish in the monsoon (the Bangladesh-border supply is freshest then) and the mochar ghonto if you want a vegetarian Bengali classic.
signature_address: HGB Road, opposite Madan Mohan Mandir, Melarmath, Dhaleswar, Agartala, Tripura 799001

name: Adi Shankar Hotel
signature_dish: Hilsa fish curry with steamed rice
why_it_matters: An old-school Bengali bhaater hotel in the heart of Agartala Bazar, often listed by long-time residents and food walks (Delhi Food Walks featured it on Facebook) as a benchmark for traditional fish-thali eating. Specialises in river fish (pabda, boal, aaar, rohu, katla) cooked the home-style Bengali way — not the dressed-up restaurant version.
insider_tip: Open 8:30 AM to 10:00 PM daily on Netaji Road. Hilsa is priced per piece (₹470-600 in 2025 reviews) — go for the cheaper rohu/katla preparations if hilsa is out of season. Lunch is when locals fill the place; come 12:30-2:00 for the freshest curry rotation.
signature_address: Netaji Road, Netaji Chowmuhani, Agartala Bazar, Agartala, Tripura 799001

name: Abhishek Hotel and Restaurant
why_it_matters: A long-running family-friendly multi-cuisine place opposite Rabindra Bhawan — central enough that everyone who's stayed in Agartala has eaten here at least once. The attached 'Pork Hut' kitchen is the rare hotel-restaurant in Tripura that takes pork seriously, which matters if you want to cross over from Bengali into the local meat tradition without going full Mui Borok.
insider_tip: Open 11:00 AM to 11:30 PM daily, AC seating + outdoor section + banquet hall (it doubles as a marriage venue, so weekend evenings get loud). Ranked #7 of 82 on Tripadvisor with active 2025 reviews. Ask for hilsa siddha or mutton kasa — the chicken bharta divides reviewers.
signature_address: Durgabari Road, Opposite Rabindra Bhawan, Palace Compound, Agartala, Tripura 799001

name: Eatopia Zannat Restaurant and Banquet
why_it_matters: AMC City Center on the second floor — the closest Agartala has to a 'mall food' upgrade, with claimed Tripadvisor listing and active 2024 reviews. Strong on tandoor-grills and Indo-Chinese, popular with families and birthday parties (the banquet doubles as private events). Useful if you've had two Bengali-thali days in a row and need a kabab/paneer reset.
insider_tip: AMC City Center, 2nd floor — entry via the mall, not a street-front. Open lunch and dinner. Reshmi kabab and paneer kulcha are the most-praised across reviews. Avoid the mocktails (one reviewer flagged the Tango Sunrise as too sweet).
signature_address: AMC City Center, 2nd Floor, Paradise Chowmuhani, HGB Road, Melarmath, Dhaleswar, Agartala, Tripura 799001

name: Kurkuma Restaurant & Cafe
signature_dish: Mui Borok platter with bamboo shoot and berma
why_it_matters: One of the few Agartala restaurants that explicitly markets Tripuri/Mui Borok cuisine to outsiders rather than burying it in a multi-cuisine menu. Sits near the Airport Road / 79 Tilla cluster, listed on both Zomato and Justdial (38 ratings) with continuous activity. The cafe-style format makes it less intimidating than tribal-village home cooking for first-time visitors.
insider_tip: Located in the Gorkha Basti area near the Tripura Secretariat / Airport Road. Ask specifically for the Mui Borok platter and pork wahan mosdeng — those are the dishes you can't easily find at Bengali-leaning restaurants like Khunti Kadai or Adi Shankar. Confirm hours by phone before going (it's smaller than the city-centre places).
signature_address: Gorkha Basti, 79 Tilla, Airport Road, Agartala Secretariat area, Agartala, Tripura 799010

name: Three 81
why_it_matters: The signature multi-cuisine restaurant of Hotel Polo Towers Agartala — Tripura's first 5-star — and the largest buffet in the city at 4,000 sq ft overlooking Nehru Park. The name comes from Agartala's STD code (381). Hilsa fish fry is the chef's flagship; the buffet breakfast is the easy choice on a tight morning before a Neermahal day-trip.
insider_tip: Open 24 hours (round-the-clock per the hotel website) with breakfast/lunch/dinner buffet windows. Located inside Hotel Polo Towers, VIP Road, Kunjaban. Buffet pricing isn't published online — call ahead. Sky Grill (the poolside grill in the same hotel) is the alternative for an outdoor barbecue evening.
signature_address: Hotel Polo Towers, VIP Road, Kunjaban, Agartala, Tripura 799006

name: Roasted Beans Cafe
why_it_matters: Agartala's coffee-and-cake hangout — the closest the city gets to a metropolitan cafe culture. Used by college students, work-from-cafe visitors and tourists who want a wifi/AC pause between sightseeing. Listed on Zomato, Swiggy, Justdial, Mappls — multi-platform presence is the cleanest signal of an active, currently-operating cafe.
insider_tip: Open 12:00 PM to 10:00 PM. The HGB Road / Kunjaban location is the original; there's a second outlet at 79 Tilla. Coffee + waffles is the move; the full-meal pasta and burger menu is fine but not the reason to come.
signature_address: HGB Road, Kunjaban, Guwala Basti, Agartala, Tripura 799006

name: Heritage Restaurant
why_it_matters: One of the rare Agartala restaurants that puts Tripuri breakfast on the daily menu rather than only at dinner — multiple food bloggers and Justdial reviewers come specifically for the morning thali. Affordable (~₹450 for two per Justdial), centrally located in Krishna Nagar, and a useful first stop for visitors who want to taste Tripuri food without committing to a full Mui Borok dinner.
insider_tip: Open from ~10:30 AM Sundays and ~11:00 AM weekdays through evening. Located on HGB Road / Advisor Chowmohani in Krishna Nagar. The Tripuri breakfast section is the reason to come — order it before they shift the menu to Chinese/North Indian by lunch.
signature_address: Advisor Chowmohani, HGB Road, Krishna Nagar, Agartala, Tripura 799002
